common.fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

newsletterConfirm.subject: Confirm your subscription to the Krizaka blog
newsletterConfirm.preheader: One click to confirm. The link is valid for {hours} hours.
newsletterConfirm.heading: Confirm your subscription
newsletterConfirm.body: Someone, probably you, asked to receive the new posts of the Krizaka blog at this address.
newsletterConfirm.expiry: The link is valid for {hours} hours.
newsletterConfirm.ignore: If it wasn't you, ignore this email: nothing was recorded, and you won't hear from us again.
newsletterConfirm.why: You receive this email because this address was entered in the subscription form of blog.krizaka.com.

newsletterWelcome.subject: You're subscribed to the Krizaka blog
newsletterWelcome.preheader: Thank you. A short email for each new post, nothing else.
newsletterWelcome.heading: Thank you, you're in
newsletterWelcome.body: You will get an email when a new post is published. Nothing else, no tracking, and you can leave in one click at the bottom of any of them.
newsletterWelcome.why: You receive this email because you subscribed to the new posts of blog.krizaka.com and confirmed it.

newPost.subject: New on the Krizaka blog: {title}
newPost.why: You receive this email because you subscribed to the new posts of blog.krizaka.com and confirmed it.
newPost.whyOn: You receive this email because you subscribed to the new posts of blog.krizaka.com on {date} and confirmed it.

newsletterUnsubscribed.subject: You're unsubscribed from the Krizaka blog
newsletterUnsubscribed.preheader: Done. Your address is removed and nothing is kept.
newsletterUnsubscribed.heading: You're unsubscribed
newsletterUnsubscribed.body: Done: your address is removed from our list, and we keep nothing about it. You will not receive any more posts.
newsletterUnsubscribed.changedMind: Changed your mind? You can subscribe again at any time.
newsletterUnsubscribed.why: You receive this one-time email because you unsubscribed from blog.krizaka.com. It is the last one.

contactAutoreply.subject: We received your message
contactAutoreply.preheader: Thank you for writing to Krizaka. We read every message.
contactAutoreply.heading: We received your message
contactAutoreply.body: Thank you for writing to Krizaka. We read every message and answer it ourselves.
contactAutoreply.why: You receive this email because you sent a message through the contact form of www.krizaka.com. It is a one-time confirmation.

contactNotification.subject: [krizaka.com] {topic}: {name}
contactNotification.heading: New message from the contact form
contactNotification.name: Name
contactNotification.why: Internal notification: a visitor used the contact form of www.krizaka.com.

signInLink.subject: Your sign-in link for {brand}
signInLink.heading: Sign in to {brand}
signInLink.body: Use the button below to sign in. The link works once and is valid for {minutes} minutes.
signInLink.ignore: If you didn't ask to sign in, ignore this email: nobody can get in without this link.
signInLink.why: You receive this email because someone asked for a sign-in link for this address.

commentReply.subject: {name} replied to your comment
commentReply.heading: {name} replied to your comment
commentReply.why: You receive this email because someone replied to a comment you wrote.

accountDeletion.subject: Confirm the deletion of your {brand} account
accountDeletion.preheader: Nothing is deleted until you confirm. The link is valid for {hours} hours.
accountDeletion.heading: Confirm the deletion of your account
accountDeletion.body: You asked to delete your {brand} account and the data attached to it. This cannot be undone. Nothing is deleted until you confirm.
accountDeletion.expiry: The link is valid for {hours} hours.
accountDeletion.ignore: If it wasn't you, ignore this email and your account stays as it is.
accountDeletion.why: You receive this email because the deletion of your account was requested.

dataExport.subject: Your {brand} data export is ready
dataExport.preheader: The download is available for {days} days.
dataExport.heading: Your data export is ready
dataExport.body: You asked for a copy of your data. It is ready to download for {days} days, then it is deleted.
dataExport.why: You receive this email because a copy of your data was requested.

confirmEmail.subject: Confirm your {brand} address
confirmEmail.preheader: One click to activate your account. The link is valid for {hours} hours.
confirmEmail.heading: Confirm your address
confirmEmail.body: Open the link below to confirm your address and activate your {brand} account. It is valid for {hours} hours.
confirmEmail.ignore: If you didn't create an account, ignore this email: nothing is activated without this link.
confirmEmail.why: You receive this email because this address was used to create an account.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your {brand} password
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: Use the button below to choose a new password for your {brand} account. The link works once and is valid for {minutes} minutes.
passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't ask for it, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.
passwordReset.why: You receive this email because a password reset was requested for this address.

emailChange.subject: Confirm your new {brand} address
emailChange.preheader: The change is applied when you open the link. Valid for {hours} hours.
emailChange.heading: Confirm your new address
emailChange.body: You asked to use this address for your {brand} account. Open the link below to confirm the change. It is valid for {hours} hours.
emailChange.ignore: If it wasn't you, ignore this email: the address of the account stays as it is.
emailChange.why: You receive this email because this address was given as the new address of an account.

shareLink.subject: {name} shared a {brand} report with you
shareLink.preheader: {name} sent you a read-only link, valid until {date}.
shareLink.heading: {name} shared a report with you
shareLink.body: {name} sent you a read-only link on {brand}. Open it to read; nothing can be changed from it.
shareLink.ignore: If you weren't expecting this, ignore this email: nothing happens unless you open the link.
shareLink.why: You receive this email because {name} chose to share a link with you.

bookingReceipt.subject: Booked: {service} at {business}
bookingReceipt.heading: Your booking is confirmed
bookingReceipt.why: You receive this email because you booked a visit with {business}.
